retry: Evidence validation failed: {error} Reconsider this judgment using the unchanged source evidence. Return a complete response with source-bound quotations or valid excerpts.
quote_length: evidence.{side}[{index}] has {length} characters; the limit is 240. Return a shorter exact quotation from the same matched center, or its first five and last five words separated by ' ... '. Keep both parts verbatim and in source order; the complete excerpt must still fit within 240 characters. Do not paraphrase.
attribution: evidence.{side}[{index}]: quote {quote} is not an exact quotation or valid five-word-endpoint excerpt from its required center, {expected}. {occurrence} Copy a short exact quotation from the required center's full_text or resolve its existing full_text_refs; do not borrow from another unit or neighbor. A quotation's presence elsewhere does not establish a role match.
array_length: evidence.{side} has {received}; expected exactly {expected}. For this selection the array lengths are evidence.focus: {focus_count}, evidence.target: {target_count}. Required member order: {positions}. Use one short exact substring per center, not one quote for the entire group or multiple quotes for one center. Preserve punctuation. Every quotation must still pass source attribution and length checks.
